firstPlayerRule: Choose the player with the biggest sweet tooth to reveal the first card.
clarifications: Card revealing continues clockwise. The rules say any player may reveal next if players lose track of whose turn it is; this does not change the game.
internalEvidence: The indexed text of the original Pegasus Spiele English PDF, printed page 6, names the player with the greatest liking for sweets and clockwise order; printed page 7 permits any revealer if turn order is lost. The PDF's publishing details credit Pegasus Spiele in 2017. This retailer-hosted PDF denied a direct download on 2026-09-23, so no rendered-page or file-hash check was possible. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-23: Rechecked the cited starter instruction and edition attribution.
uncertainty: The rules do not define a tie-break for players claiming the same sweet tooth.
